messages.3コインのS1「抜剣」を主力にマッチを取り、速度で上回る相手にはS2、体力の多い: A fragile, offense-focused Identity that mainly clashes with her 3-Coin S1 Draw of the Sword. Use S2 against slower enemies and S3 against enemies with high HP.
messages.S1「抜剣」: スキル1ながら3コインで、攻撃レベルは人格Lv+3。コインが多い: **S1 — Pulled Blade**: Despite being Skill 1, it has 3 Coins and an Offense Level of Identity Lv +3. With many Coins, a single Tails rarely loses her the Clash. Coin Ⅱ inflicts 2 Rupture on hit (only on Heads Hit at lower Uptie), and Coin Ⅲ inflicts 1 Rupture on Heads Hit.
messages.S2「背後斬り」: 2コイン。対象より速度が速ければ、各コインのダメージ量+20: **S2 — Backslash**: 2 Coins. If she is faster than the target, each Coin deals +20% damage (+10% at lower Uptie).
messages.S3「突き抜く」: 1コインでコイン威力+14。対象の体力が50%以上ならダメー: **S3 — Piercing Thrust**: 1 Coin with +14 Coin Power. +20% damage if the target has 50% or more HP, and Rupture Count increases by 1 on hit.
messages.耐久の低さ: 防御レベルは人格Lv-4。マッチに負けたときの被害が大きいので、ぶ: **Low durability**: Her Defense Level is Identity Lv −4. Losing Clashes hurts a lot, so she needs to pick who to throw her skills at.
messages.パッシブ: バトルパッシブ「処刑」(怠惰×4・保有)は精神力0未満の対象への与ダ: **Passives**: The combat passive Executor (4 Sloth Owned) gives +10% damage against targets below 0 SP. The support passive Military Mindset (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +30% damage to the 1 ally with the highest current HP when attacking enemies below 0 SP.
messages.S1はコインが多くマッチが安定するので、主力として積極的に振る。ただしS1の威力: S1 has many Coins and stable Clashes, so use it actively as her main skill. However, S1's power range is narrow, so avoid Clashing strong skills with it and deflect those with S3's high Coin Power instead. Use S2 against opponents she can outspeed, and land S3 on high-HP enemies early in the fight for a big chunk of damage that leads into allies' follow-ups. S1 and S2 alone cover the resources for her starting E.G.O To Páthos Máthos, making her self-sufficient.
